originals.citation: Bowers, L., Brennan, G., Flood, C., Lipang, M., & Oladapo, P. (2006). Preliminary outcomes of a trial to reduce conflict and containment on acute psychiatric wards: City Nurses. Journal of Psychiatric and Mental Health Nursing, 13, 165-172.

quote: A previous test of an intervention based on these principles, on two wards, showed a good outcome. In this study, we tested the same intervention on three further wards.
notes: Brennan 2006 and Flood 2006 are qualitative process papers from the same project, not the outcome test.
